# イラスト依頼文：物価（ChatGPT web、1チャット4枚まで、1行で送る）

共通：画風＝落ち着いた夜の紺色と、あたたかい金色のアクセント。絵画風の semi-realistic イラスト。**画像内に文字・数字・ロゴ・値札の文字を入れない。実在人物の顔を描かない。**横長（16:9）。文字を重ねるので、全体に暗めで、細かい模様を入れすぎない。

保存名（assets/bukka/）：art_intro / art_office / art_shop / art_home / art_wallet / thumb_art

## チャット1
1. art_intro：Dark navy night illustration, a wicker shopping basket on a kitchen table filled with vegetables, rice, bread and a small carton, warm lamp light, a faint glowing golden line chart rising in the background without any numbers or labels, calm thoughtful mood, painterly semi-realistic style, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, wide 16:9 composition, dark overall with warm gold accents
2. art_office：Dark painterly illustration of a quiet statistics office at night with no people, rows of tidy desks with computer monitors showing abstract blurred charts without any readable text, a green-shaded lamp glowing warmly, shelves of binders in shadow, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy and warm gold tones
3. art_shop：Dark painterly illustration of a supermarket aisle at night with no people, shelves of rice bags, vegetables and groceries, blank price tags with no writing, warm overhead lights reflecting on the floor, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy with warm gold lights
4. art_home：Dark painterly illustration of a small apartment living room at evening with no people, a dining table with a bowl of rice and a lamp, a window showing a city at dusk, a utility bill envelope with blank face on the table, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, wide 16:9 composition, dark navy with warm gold accents
